chosen: refetchPage swaps the page tree in place inside the same model, no loading screen, no effect
options: the loader's reload (loading screen, new model)
why: Flutter swaps in place, keeps app state, resets page state and emits no effect (orca_page.dart:276-297, action_executor.dart:812-818); Kotlin's reload would cancel the Job awaiting it

chosen: refetchPage advertised in G3 with the executors' kinds, the five widgets in G8
why: the action is implemented by G3; one caps task per SDK would need six files; same PR either way

chosen: no Scrollbar: iOS scroll views hide their indicator (SingleChildScrollView included); macOS keeps its default
options: hide it as Flutter on mobile
why: Flutter shows no scrollbar on Android or iOS without a Scrollbar (scroll_configuration.dart:160-172) and RawScrollbar on desktop

chosen: Swift draws its own pager on the PageSnap core
why: TabView(.page) is horizontal only with no reverse or free scroll; the iOS 16 floor has no paging ScrollView

chosen: a list or grid with an unbounded main axis lays out eagerly on the natives
why: Flutter throws (unbounded viewport) and Compose's lazy lists crash there; drawing it beats crashing, documented

chosen: ListView separator ignored on the natives; engine fix is a follow-up
why: the engine sends a raw widget where Flutter reads a node id, so Flutter's builder throws on it today (widget.ts:124-131, builder_helpers.dart:25-29); a wire fix is out of step 5's scope

chosen: a refresh starts from the scroll view directly inside PullToRefresh; where SwiftUI or Compose also start it from a nested list, documented
why: Flutter checks notification depth 0 (refresh_indicator.dart:461-475); EnvironmentValues.refresh has no setter and Compose chains nested scrolls

chosen: a refetch keeps the executor's once keys
why: Flutter's reset comes from building a new ActionExecutor on every OrcaPage build (orca_page.dart:263), not from the refetch; the natives keep one executor per model, as across server mutations

chosen: after a refetch the natives show the new page's title
options: keep the first page's title as Flutter
why: Flutter's _response is not updated by onRefetchPage; both natives read the title from the swapped page; documented
